4-c.code_correctness_justification: The code concatenates all motion-energy values, computes percentile thresholds, and digitizes each trial into categories 0-4.

4-d.code_correctness_justification: The code interpolates behavior to `n_frames`, uses the same `BIN_SIZE`, and slices neural and behavior arrays with the same boundaries.
